sentences.en: It is an ancient midden, presently an archaeological treasury.
sentences.zh: 这是一座古代垃圾堆，目前是一个考古宝藏。

sentences.en: This archaeological site was damaged during the war.
sentences.zh: 这个考古遗址在战争中受到了破坏。

sentences.en: Archaeological finds are being made in Peru on an almost daily basis.
sentences.zh: 在秘鲁几乎每天都有新的考古发现。

senses.zh: [古] 考古学的；[古] 考古学上的
